state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done; Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. `Core\Ldap`, `Core\Ldap\Filter`, `Core\Ldap\Dn`, `Core\Ldap\Sid`, `Core\Ldap\Ad`, `Core\Ldap\Change`, `Core\Ldap\Ad\GroupType` and `Core\Ldap\Ad\AccountFlags` owe nothing.

**What is still owed:** `Core\Ldap\Entry::isDeleted` owes `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench. `Core\Ldap\Connection` (`setPassword`, `changePassword`, `compare`), `Core\Ldap\Entries` (`references`, `total`) and `Core\Ldap\Changes::cookie` owe everything, and `total` and `cookie` also owe a Rust test with a `covers:` marker.

**The proof trees are granted `[ldap.corp]` by directory** in the root `nvs.toml`, under each of the three trees, for `Ldap-Entry`, `Ldap-Ad-GroupType` and `Ldap-Ad-AccountFlags`. A new directory such as `Ldap-Connection` or `Ldap-Entries` needs its own `[[app]] root` grant in all three trees, and an `[[app]] root` that names a missing directory fails every program in the repository with `E0605`. Check a draft with `bun nv proofs --run --id '<feature>' --show`: it takes **one** `--id`, and a second is ignored. `--bless` takes files, never a directory. `--record-perf` fails its calibration while `bun nv verify` runs, and verify's build fails on a locked `nvs.exe` while a proof run is going, so run the two one after the other. `--record-perf` over ten LDAP benches takes more than ten minutes, so start it in the background.

**`[ldap.corp]` binds as the read-only `Reader`**, so it can run `compare` but neither `setPassword` nor `changePassword`. The seed (`tests/db/compose.yaml:356`) has `Administrator` with `Novis-test-1` and the users with `Novis-user-1`. A write example needs either a second block that binds as a user who may write, or a program that changes a password and changes it back in the same run so that the seeded state stays the same for every other proof. Decide that first, and keep the block name neutral (`[ldap.corp]` style, never `admin` as a judgement).

**The `samba-ad` domain is seeded** by `20-novis-seed` in `tests/db/compose.yaml` (its comment lists every user, group and password). People are `CN=Anna Berg`, `CN=Ben Kohl`, `CN=Carla Diaz` and `CN=Dora Lind` under `OU=Company`.

**Seeded facts a proof can print:** RIDs follow the seed order (`Reader` 1103, `Employees` 1104, `Managers` 1105, `Newsletter` 1106, `anna.berg` 1107, `ben.kohl` 1108, `dora.lind` 1110), `Administrator` is 500. `userAccountControl` is 512 for `anna.berg` and `carla.diaz`, 514 for `dora.lind` and 66048 for `ben.kohl` and `Reader`. `carla.diaz` has `pwdLastSet` 0. Nobody is locked out. A search for `objectClass=user` under `OU=Company` finds the five users, `Reader` among them. `groupType` is -2147483646 for `Employees` and `Managers` and 2 for `Newsletter`. The domain has `maxPwdAge` 6w, `minPwdLength` 7 and `pwdHistoryLength` 24. GUIDs, SIDs and timestamps differ per boot.

**`Reader` cannot read any attribute of a deleted object**, so `isDeleted()` is `false` on everything it can find, and the seed deletes nothing.
